claim_impact.attribution: The public response to Sun–Feng–Zhang already proposes a local-quench resonance diagnostic and identifies growing pair size as a detection difficulty. Macri et al. are additionally credited for adjacent-pair dynamics. The claim comparison retains the fixed-source, unconditional coincidence theorem and deterministic-time proof as the assessed contribution.
